Roadmap.description: After the form, the request enters the PixelRing service process: we store the details, issue a PR number, review the case and name the next step.

steps.description: A specialist checks the description, photos and site details: what happened, where is the sign, what details are missing?

items.question: How quickly can PixelRing respond?
items.answer: It depends on the city, access, urgency and type of sign. With photos and an address, PixelRing can assess faster whether a short-notice visit, pre-check or planned appointment makes sense.

items.question: Are photos enough to start?
items.answer: Often yes. Useful photos show the whole sign, a close-up of the damage, facade or lightbox access and, if visible, the power supply or connection area. If anything is missing, PixelRing asks specifically.

items.question: Which signs does PixelRing repair?
items.answer: Typical cases include LED signs, lightboxes, channel letters, neon or contour lighting, facade advertising, window film, lettering and visible branding elements at business locations.

items.question: Does PixelRing work across Germany?
items.answer: Yes, requests can be reviewed and coordinated throughout Germany. Berlin is the central base; for other regions, the service route depends on task, access and availability.

items.question: Will I receive an offer before work begins?
items.answer: Yes. Scope, next step and conditions are aligned before execution. If the damage is unclear, a diagnosis or site inspection may be needed first.

items.question: Is there a warranty on the work?
items.answer: Completed work is accompanied by suitable warranty conditions. Details depend on the work, components, manufacturer terms and condition of the existing sign.

items.question: Can several branches be handled?
items.answer: Yes. PixelRing can bundle several sites with address, photos, priority and task type so urgent defects and planned work are coordinated separately.

items.question: Does PixelRing also handle dismantling?
items.answer: Yes. Dismantling, removal, relocation or preparation of a new surface can be reviewed. Photos, height, fixing method, substrate and access are important.

items.question: What if replacement parts are needed?
items.answer: PixelRing clarifies whether LED modules, power supplies, films, letters or other components are available, or whether a technical alternative makes more sense.

items.question: What applies in urgent cases?
items.answer: If parts are loose, there is a burning smell, sparks, water ingress or electrical risk, the sign should not continue operating. Send photos and address so the urgency can be assessed.

Reviews.title: Typical Service Cases
Reviews.subtitle: Anonymized examples of signage problems PixelRing records, checks, and coordinates with specialists.

items.name: Flickering LED Sign
items.content: An LED sign flickers visibly and affects the storefront. PixelRing collects photos, location details, and the fault description, checks the sensible next step, and coordinates diagnosis or repair.

items.name: Damaged Exterior Lettering
items.content: Letters, films, or lightboxes are damaged by weather, renovation, or wear. PixelRing documents the condition, clarifies materials and mounting requirements, and prepares the right execution path.

items.name: Installation After Renovation
items.content: After a renovation or move, existing signage needs to be adapted, repositioned, or reinstalled. PixelRing brings the request, measurements, and photos together and plans the work with the responsible specialists.
